objective: Improve orjson dumps+loads throughput across frozen dataclass, datetime, NumPy, Unicode, and nested corpora. Maximize the geometric mean throughput after byte-exact dumps, semantic loads, full upstream pytest, and peak-RSS gates; only src/lib.rs, src/serialize/, and src/deserialize/ are mutable.

meta.provenance: Current-head OSS-T08 layered on ijl/orjson 705515d77b28429d0b7c30c3d781abe52e8a1e5a (3.11.9); the pinned baseline commit is a synthetic overlay commit that adds the trusted evaluator glue (eval.py, benchmark_worker.py, orjson_workload.py, test_conductor.py, challenge.json) on top of that upstream tree so the visible baseline matches the declared commit byte-for-byte. No reference artifact or known winning patch. Round-5 hardening (EXEC-BOUNDARY): the pytest correctness gate is produced by a trusted conductor process that NEVER imports the candidate extension — it drives one pytest subprocess per test file, each writing its own JUnit report at session finish, and derives pass/fail solely from each child's exit code plus its own count of files that reached session finish, measured against the frozen per-file set and an identity sha256 over the exact sorted pass/skip <file>/<class>/<name> set. No nonce or record fd is delivered into any process that loads the extension, so candidate module-init has nothing to scrape and no in-process channel it can author; an early os._exit before session finish yields no report and drops the completed-file count below the frozen expectation. The sound benchmark chain is unchanged: every iteration is a data-dependent serialize/parse chain validated against a pristine in-parent reference orjson over a per-run-unpredictable nonce; peak RSS is cgroup2 memory.peak of the whole worker tree; q is the interleaved pristine-reference yardstick (paired geomean of ref/cand time over 9 pairs). Local A-A calibration set qReference = qBase + max(5*sigma, 0.05*abs(qBase-qFail)). Numbers are provisional pending frozen-GCE recalibration.

toolchain.optimizerRuntime: nodejs (proxy relay) + bun 1.3.14 + pi_natives 16.5.2 baked beside bun for mutation sandboxes; unused by the trusted evaluator

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max
measurement.q: per workload, the paired geomean over 9 interleaved candidate/reference pairs of (pristine-reference chain time / candidate chain time); the per-pair ratio cancels shared host load. Per-split q is the geometric mean across the ten frozen dumps+loads workloads (~1.0 == pristine baseline speed); train+validation aggregate is their arithmetic mean. Every timed run is a data-dependent serialize/parse chain whose final digest is validated against the pristine reference over a per-run-unpredictable nonce.

rss.envelopeConstruction: cgroup2 memory.peak of the whole benchmark worker tree (~46 MiB validation high-water), rounded up to a 50 MiB envelope
rss.limitConstruction: 60 MiB (envelope * ~1.2) headroom for measurement jitter under host contention
rss.source: kernel cgroup2 memory.peak (whole-tree, non-resettable), replacing round-2 VmRSS 5 ms polling
